mechanism: IFN-gamma-induced, TRPC1-mediated Ca2+ entry is needed for STAT1 and NF-kB p65 phosphorylation during M1 polarization
sentence: TRPC1 Deficiency Results in Reduced IFNgamma-Induced Phosphorylation of STAT1 and NF-kappaB as well as Impaired Production of M1 Inflammatory Mediators in Peritoneal Macrophages In Vivo
justification: TRPC1-/- and TRPC1 siRNA macrophages lose IFN-gamma-induced pSTAT1. Context: mouse bone-marrow and peritoneal macrophages.

mechanism: TRPC1-mediated Ca2+ influx is required for IFN-gamma induction of NOS2 in M1 macrophages
sentence: IFNgamma exposure of TRPC1-sufficient BM macrophages that either are isolated from WT mice or were transfected with non-targeting siRNA (M1-siC) displayed induced expression of NOS2, TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-23, CXCL9, and CXCL10 (Figures 4C and S7).
justification: Induction is lost in TRPC1-/- or TRPC1-silenced macrophages; IFN-gamma-induced Ca2+ influx is TRPC1-mediated.

mechanism: TRPC1-mediated Ca2+ influx is required for IFN-gamma induction of TNF-alpha in M1 macrophages
sentence: IFNgamma exposure of TRPC1-sufficient BM macrophages that either are isolated from WT mice or were transfected with non-targeting siRNA (M1-siC) displayed induced expression of NOS2, TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-23, CXCL9, and CXCL10 (Figures 4C and S7).
justification: Induction is lost in TRPC1-/- or TRPC1-silenced macrophages.

mechanism: TRPC1-mediated Ca2+ influx is required for IFN-gamma induction of IL-6 in M1 macrophages

justification: Induction is lost in TRPC1-/- or TRPC1-silenced macrophages.

mechanism: HNF4alpha binds the Stim1 promoter and represses its transcription; high glucose weakens this binding, releasing STIM1 and SOCE
sentence: Moreover, knockdown of HNF4alpha significantly augmented store-operated Ca(2+) entry, which is known to be gated by STIM1 and has recently been found to be antifibrotic in MCs.
justification: HNF4alpha knockdown raises STIM1 mRNA and protein, overexpression lowers STIM1 (HEK293). Context: human glomerular mesangial cells.

mechanism: HNF4alpha knockdown raises Orai1 mRNA alongside STIM1 in mesangial cells
sentence: Knockdown of HNF4alpha using a small interfering RNA approach significantly increased mRNA expression levels of both STIM1 and Orai1 and protein expression levels of STIM1 in cultured human MCs.
justification: siRNA against HNF4alpha increases ORAI1 mRNA.

mechanism: homeostatic ORAI1 Ca2+ entry sustains expression of Ca2+-dependent transcription factors (AP-1 family, MEF2C) and tonic IFN-I signalling
sentence: Transcriptome analysis showed downregulation of multiple antiviral signaling pathways in ORAI1 knockout cells, likely because of reduced expression of the Ca2+-dependent transcription factors of the AP-1 family and MEF2C Accordingly, modulation of homeostatic Ca2+ concentration by pretreatment with ORAI1 blocker or agonist could influence baseline IFNB expression and resistance to SARS-CoV-2 infection in a human lung epithelial cell line.
justification: ORAI1 knockout HEK293-ACE2 cells have reduced MEF2C expression.

mechanism: ORAI1-dependent homeostatic Ca2+ sets tonic IFN-beta levels and resistance to SARS-CoV-2
sentence: Transcriptome analysis showed downregulation of multiple antiviral signaling pathways in ORAI1 knockout cells, likely because of reduced expression of the Ca2+-dependent transcription factors of the AP-1 family and MEF2C Accordingly, modulation of homeostatic Ca2+ concentration by pretreatment with ORAI1 blocker or agonist could influence baseline IFNB expression and resistance to SARS-CoV-2 infection in a human lung epithelial cell line.
justification: ORAI1 blocker or agonist shifts baseline IFNB expression; ORAI1 knockout impairs tonic IFN-I signalling.

mechanism: SOCE through Orai1, via CaMK2/CaMKK2, is needed for IFN-gamma-induced PD-L1 expression in OSCC
sentence: Pharmacological inhibition of store-operated calcium entry (SOCE) using the Orai1 inhibitor Synta66 suppressed IFN-gamma-induced PD-L1 expression in a dose-dependent manner.
justification: Synta66 and Orai1 knockdown attenuate IFN-gamma-induced PD-L1. Context: oral squamous cell carcinoma cells.

mechanism: Orai1 knockdown attenuates IFN-gamma-induced PD-L1
sentence: Consistently, knockdown of Orai1 or STIM1 attenuated PD-L1 induction under IFN-gamma stimulation, while basal expression remained unchanged.
justification: Genetic confirmation of the Synta66 effect.

mechanism: STIM1 knockdown attenuates IFN-gamma-induced PD-L1 via loss of SOCE-CaMK signalling
sentence: Consistently, knockdown of Orai1 or STIM1 attenuated PD-L1 induction under IFN-gamma stimulation, while basal expression remained unchanged.
justification: STIM1 siRNA reduces PD-L1 induction in OSCC cells; title: Orai1- and STIM1-mediated calcium signaling controls PD-L1 expression.

mechanism: STIM2 scaffolds CaMKK2 with AMPK; Ca2+ rise promotes the interaction and STIM2 loss blunts Ca2+-induced AMPK activation
sentence: We reveal that STIM2 interacts with AMPK and CaMKK2 and that the increase in intracellular calcium levels promotes AMPK colocalization and interaction with STIM2.
justification: Co-IP of STIM2 with CaMKK2; STIM1 does not bind AMPK.

mechanism: SGK3 sustains STIM2 transcript and protein in dendritic cells; sgk3-/- DCs have reduced SOC entry and migration
sentence: STIM2 transcript levels and protein abundance were significantly lower in sgk3(-/-) DCs than in sgk3(+/+) DCs, whereas Orai1, Orai2, STIM1 and TRPC1 transcript levels and/or protein abundance were similar in sgk3-/- and sgk3(+/+) DCs.
justification: sgk3 knockout lowers STIM2 specifically, with reduced SOCE. Context: bone-marrow-derived dendritic cells.

mechanism: PDLIM5 (ENH1) and its muscle splice variant ENH4 co-immunoprecipitate with TRPC1 and tune TRPC1-mediated SOCE in myoblasts
sentence: Scaffold Protein PDLIM5 Regulates TRPC1 Calcium Channel Mediated Store-Operated Calcium Entry in Mouse Myoblasts.
justification: Immunoprecipitation showed a physical interaction between ENH1/ENH4 and TRPC1. Context: C2C12 myoblasts.

mechanism: ENH1 knockdown lowers TRPC1 and STIM1 mRNA and impairs SOCE
sentence: ENH1 siRNA knockdown significantly downregulated TRPC1 and STIM1 mRNA expression, increased basal cytosolic Ca2+ level, and impaired SOCE response and myotube maturation.
justification: siRNA against ENH1 (PDLIM5) reduces TRPC1 mRNA.

mechanism: ENH1 knockdown lowers TRPC1 and STIM1 mRNA and impairs SOCE
sentence: ENH1 siRNA knockdown significantly downregulated TRPC1 and STIM1 mRNA expression, increased basal cytosolic Ca2+ level, and impaired SOCE response and myotube maturation.
justification: siRNA against ENH1 (PDLIM5) reduces STIM1 mRNA.

mechanism: high glucose upregulates STIM/ORAI through Ca2+-calcineurin-NFATc3 in vascular endothelium
sentence: HG-induced upregulation of ORAI and STIM genes was prevented by the calcineurin inhibitor cyclosporin A and NFATc3 siRNA.
justification: NFATc3 siRNA prevents high-glucose upregulation of STIM genes; confirmed with NFAT inhibitor in Akita mice.

mechanism: high glucose upregulates STIM/ORAI through Ca2+-calcineurin-NFATc3 in vascular endothelium
sentence: HG-induced upregulation of ORAI and STIM genes was prevented by the calcineurin inhibitor cyclosporin A and NFATc3 siRNA.
justification: NFATc3 siRNA prevents high-glucose upregulation of ORAI genes.

mechanism: Oct4 silencing upregulates STIM1 and Orai1, enhances SOC entry and drives EMT, rescued by STIM1 silencing
sentence: Silencing Oct4 also upregulated expression of two major components of store-operated Ca(2+) entry channels (SOCs), STIM1 and Orai1, and enhanced SOC-directed Ca(2+) influx.
justification: siRNA against Oct4 raises STIM1. Context: MCF-7 breast cancer cells.

mechanism: Oct4 silencing upregulates STIM1 and Orai1 and enhances SOC entry
sentence: Silencing Oct4 also upregulated expression of two major components of store-operated Ca(2+) entry channels (SOCs), STIM1 and Orai1, and enhanced SOC-directed Ca(2+) influx.
justification: siRNA against Oct4 raises ORAI1. Context: MCF-7 cells.

mechanism: Fas activation lowers STIM1 protein in a caspase-dependent way, inhibiting SOCE in apoptotic T cells
sentence: Here we show that activation of Fas receptor in T-cells results in caspase-dependent decrease of cellular STIM1 and Orai1 protein content.
justification: Fas ligation reduces STIM1 protein. Context: Jurkat T cells.

mechanism: Fas activation lowers Orai1 protein in a caspase-dependent way, inhibiting SOCE in apoptotic T cells
sentence: Here we show that activation of Fas receptor in T-cells results in caspase-dependent decrease of cellular STIM1 and Orai1 protein content.
